FROM kafkabeat-lag, kafkabeat-metrics
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 2 minutes AND NOT STARTS_WITH(kafka.topic.name, "__")
| EVAL consumed = CASE(event.dataset == "kafkabeat.lag" AND kafka.lag.state != "gone" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 30 seconds, 1, 0)
| STATS consumed = MAX(consumed) BY kafka.cluster.name, kafka.topic.name
| STATS `Tracked topics` = COUNT(*), `Consumed topics` = SUM(consumed)
| EVAL `Topics without group` = `Tracked topics` - `Consumed topics`

FROM kafkabeat-lag
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 30 seconds
    AND kafka.consumergroup.state IN ("PreparingRebalance", "CompletingRebalance", "Assigning", "Reconciling")
| EVAL group = CONCAT(kafka.cluster.name, "/", kafka.consumergroup.id)
| STATS `Groups rebalancing` = COUNT_DISTINCT(group)

FROM kafkabeat-lag
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 30 seconds AND kafka.lag.state != "gone"
| EVAL lag_s = COALESCE(kafka.lag.seconds_upper, kafka.lag.seconds_lower), ko = CASE(kafka.lag.state IN ("stalled", "unassigned", "no_commit") OR lag_s > 300 OR kafka.lag.flags.commit_before_log_start == true, 1, 0), last_message_ms = TO_LONG(@timestamp) - kafka.lag.last_produce_age_s * 1000
| STATS ko = MAX(ko), last_message_ms = MAX(last_message_ms) BY kafka.cluster.name, kafka.topic.name
| EVAL stopped = CASE(TO_LONG(NOW()) - last_message_ms >= 60000, 1, 0)
| STATS topics = COUNT(*), ko = SUM(ko), stopped = SUM(stopped)
| EVAL `Consumption OK` = topics - ko, `Consumption not OK` = ko, `Production active` = topics - stopped, `Production stopped` = stopped

query.esql:
FROM kafkabeat-lag
| WHERE kafka.lag.state != "gone"
| EVAL owner = COALESCE(kafka.topic.owner, "(no team)")
| STATS rate = AVG(kafka.lag.produce_rate)
    BY t = BUCKET(@timestamp, 60, ?_tstart, ?_tend), kafka.cluster.name, kafka.topic.name, owner
| STATS `Produce rate (msg/s)` = SUM(rate) BY t, `Team` = owner
| LIMIT 10000

FROM kafkabeat-lag
| WHERE kafka.lag.state != "gone"
| EVAL owner = COALESCE(kafka.topic.owner, "(no team)")
| STATS rate = AVG(kafka.lag.produce_rate)
    BY t = BUCKET(@timestamp, 60, ?_tstart, ?_tend), kafka.cluster.name, kafka.topic.name, owner
| STATS `Produce rate (msg/s)` = SUM(rate) BY t, `Team` = owner
| LIMIT 10000

FROM kafkabeat-lag
| EVAL pair = CONCAT(kafka.cluster.name, "/", kafka.topic.name, "/", kafka.consumergroup.id), caught_up = CASE(kafka.lag.state == "caught_up", pair), lagging = CASE(kafka.lag.state == "lagging", pair), stalled = CASE(kafka.lag.state == "stalled", pair), unassigned = CASE(kafka.lag.state == "unassigned", pair), no_commit = CASE(kafka.lag.state == "no_commit", pair), gone = CASE(kafka.lag.state == "gone", pair)
| STATS `Caught up` = COUNT_DISTINCT(caught_up), `Lagging` = COUNT_DISTINCT(lagging), `Stalled` = COUNT_DISTINCT(stalled), `Unassigned` = COUNT_DISTINCT(unassigned), `No commit` = COUNT_DISTINCT(no_commit), `Gone` = COUNT_DISTINCT(gone)
    BY t = BUCKET(@timestamp, 60, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| LIMIT 10000

FROM kafkabeat-lag
| EVAL pair = CONCAT(kafka.cluster.name, "/", kafka.topic.name, "/", kafka.consumergroup.id), caught_up = CASE(kafka.lag.state == "caught_up", pair), lagging = CASE(kafka.lag.state == "lagging", pair), stalled = CASE(kafka.lag.state == "stalled", pair), unassigned = CASE(kafka.lag.state == "unassigned", pair), no_commit = CASE(kafka.lag.state == "no_commit", pair), gone = CASE(kafka.lag.state == "gone", pair)
| STATS `Caught up` = COUNT_DISTINCT(caught_up), `Lagging` = COUNT_DISTINCT(lagging), `Stalled` = COUNT_DISTINCT(stalled), `Unassigned` = COUNT_DISTINCT(unassigned), `No commit` = COUNT_DISTINCT(no_commit), `Gone` = COUNT_DISTINCT(gone)
    BY t = BUCKET(@timestamp, 60, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| LIMIT 10000

query.esql:
FROM kafkabeat-lag
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 30 seconds AND kafka.lag.state != "gone" AND kafka.consumergroup.type == "consumer"
| STATS `Topics` = COUNT_DISTINCT(kafka.topic.name)
    BY `Cluster` = kafka.cluster.name, `Group` = kafka.consumergroup.id, `Group state` = kafka.consumergroup.state
| SORT `Cluster`, `Group`
| LIMIT 1000

FROM kafkabeat-lag
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 30 seconds AND kafka.lag.state != "gone" AND kafka.consumergroup.type == "consumer"
| STATS `Topics` = COUNT_DISTINCT(kafka.topic.name)
    BY `Cluster` = kafka.cluster.name, `Group` = kafka.consumergroup.id, `Group state` = kafka.consumergroup.state
| SORT `Cluster`, `Group`
| LIMIT 1000

attributes.description: Cluster monitoring: tiles for the current moment (latest cycles; consumption not OK = stalled, partition without a member for 60 s, no commit, lag > 300 s or lost offsets; production stopped = no message for 60 s; groups without members = frozen commits, manual assignment excluded; loss risk = 80% of the retained log unread, or offsets below the log start; KIP-848 groups = consumer protocol, tracked by their state only), state by pair, recent activity. Tiles show now, charts show the selected range.

FROM kafkabeat-lag
| WHERE kafka.lag.state != "gone"
| STATS produce = AVG(kafka.lag.produce_rate), consume = AVG(kafka.lag.consume_rate)
    BY t = BUCKET(@timestamp, 100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), kafka.cluster.name, kafka.topic.name, kafka.consumergroup.id
| STATS produce = MAX(produce), consume = SUM(consume) BY t, kafka.cluster.name, kafka.topic.name
| STATS `Produce rate (msg/s)` = SUM(produce), `Consume rate (msg/s)` = SUM(consume) BY t
| LIMIT 10000

FROM kafkabeat-lag
| WHERE kafka.lag.state != "gone"
| STATS produce = AVG(kafka.lag.produce_rate), consume = AVG(kafka.lag.consume_rate)
    BY t = BUCKET(@timestamp, 100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), kafka.cluster.name, kafka.topic.name, kafka.consumergroup.id
| STATS produce = MAX(produce), consume = SUM(consume) BY t, kafka.cluster.name, kafka.topic.name
| STATS `Produce rate (msg/s)` = SUM(produce), `Consume rate (msg/s)` = SUM(consume) BY t
| LIMIT 10000

FROM kafkabeat-lag
| EVAL group = CONCAT(kafka.cluster.name, "/", kafka.consumergroup.id)
| STATS `Groups` = COUNT_DISTINCT(group) BY t = BUCKET(@timestamp, 100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), `Group state` = kafka.consumergroup.state
| LIMIT 10000

FROM kafkabeat-lag
| EVAL group = CONCAT(kafka.cluster.name, "/", kafka.consumergroup.id)
| STATS `Groups` = COUNT_DISTINCT(group) BY t = BUCKET(@timestamp, 100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), `Group state` = kafka.consumergroup.state
| LIMIT 10000

FROM kafkabeat-metrics
| WHERE event.dataset == "kafka.consumergroup" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 2 minutes
| EVAL client = COALESCE(kafka.consumergroup.client.id, "(unassigned)"), host = COALESCE(kafka.consumergroup.client.host, ""),
       member = COALESCE(kafka.consumergroup.client.member_id, "")
| STATS lag = MAX(kafka.consumergroup.consumer_lag), lag_s = MAX(COALESCE(kafka.lag.seconds_upper, kafka.lag.seconds_lower))
    BY kafka.cluster.name, kafka.consumergroup.id, kafka.topic.name, kafka.partition.id, client, host, member
| STATS `Partitions` = COUNT(*), `Lag (offsets)` = SUM(lag), worst = MAX(lag_s)
    BY `Group` = kafka.consumergroup.id, `Consumer` = client, `Host` = host, `Member` = member
| EVAL `Worst lag (s)` = ROUND(worst)
| KEEP `Group`, `Consumer`, `Host`, `Partitions`, `Lag (offsets)`, `Worst lag (s)`, `Member`
| SORT `Worst lag (s)` DESC
| LIMIT 1000

FROM kafkabeat-metrics
| WHERE event.dataset == "kafka.consumergroup" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 2 minutes
| EVAL client = COALESCE(kafka.consumergroup.client.id, "(unassigned)"), host = COALESCE(kafka.consumergroup.client.host, ""),
       member = COALESCE(kafka.consumergroup.client.member_id, "")
| STATS lag = MAX(kafka.consumergroup.consumer_lag), lag_s = MAX(COALESCE(kafka.lag.seconds_upper, kafka.lag.seconds_lower))
    BY kafka.cluster.name, kafka.consumergroup.id, kafka.topic.name, kafka.partition.id, client, host, member
| STATS `Partitions` = COUNT(*), `Lag (offsets)` = SUM(lag), worst = MAX(lag_s)
    BY `Group` = kafka.consumergroup.id, `Consumer` = client, `Host` = host, `Member` = member
| EVAL `Worst lag (s)` = ROUND(worst)
| KEEP `Group`, `Consumer`, `Host`, `Partitions`, `Lag (offsets)`, `Worst lag (s)`, `Member`
| SORT `Worst lag (s)` DESC
| LIMIT 1000

FROM kafkabeat-lag
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 30 seconds AND kafka.lag.state != "gone" AND kafka.lag.partitions_unassigned > 0
| STATS ids = VALUES(kafka.lag.partitions_unassigned_ids), age = MAX(kafka.lag.unassigned_age_max_s)
    BY kafka.cluster.name, `Topic` = kafka.topic.name, `Group` = kafka.consumergroup.id
| EVAL `Partitions without member` = MV_CONCAT(TO_STRING(MV_SORT(ids)), ", "), `Unassigned for (s)` = ROUND(age)
| KEEP `Topic`, `Group`, `Partitions without member`, `Unassigned for (s)`
| SORT `Unassigned for (s)` DESC
| LIMIT 1000

FROM kafkabeat-lag
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 30 seconds AND kafka.lag.state != "gone" AND kafka.lag.partitions_unassigned > 0

    BY kafka.cluster.name, `Topic` = kafka.topic.name, `Group` = kafka.consumergroup.id
